parts.title: A New Face
parts.text: Nora, Dev, and Chloe were in the same class. One morning, a new boy named Sam stood alone by the door. Nora gave him a big smile and wanted to **greet** him. Dev said, “Let’s **invite** him to sit with us at lunch. We should **include** him in our games at recess, too.”

parts.title: A Mistake at Recess
parts.text: At recess, Dev kicked the ball too hard. It hit Chloe’s paper plane and bent the wing. Dev felt bad right away. He wanted to show **respect** for his friend, so he chose to **apologize**. He told her the **honest** truth: he had not been watching. “I am sorry,” he said. Chloe took a deep breath and decided to **forgive** him.

parts.title: Making It Right
parts.text: Dev wanted to **mend** the plane, so he found some tape. That was a **thoughtful** idea. Nora wanted to **offer** her help, too. The teacher saw them and gave them some **praise**. “I see so much **kindness** in this class,” she said.

parts.title: A Good Feeling
parts.text: At the end of the day, Sam waved goodbye to his new friends. Nora, Dev, and Chloe walked home feeling proud. A few small words and actions had made someone feel at home.
